official_sources.name: ESPN Formula 1 public JSON endpoints
official_sources.note: Key-less, CORS-enabled, undocumented and unversioned (same status as the tennis endpoints).

official_sources.name: OLBG Motor Racing tips pages
official_sources.note: Tipster consensus + factual track history; no structured odds in server HTML.
fields_provided: race markets (Win Race, Fastest Qualifier, Win Tournament)

official_sources.name: Open-Meteo forecast API (key-less)
official_sources.note: Free, no key, documented; used for the permitted weather reference only.

irregularities.title: No structured bookmaker odds on any free key-less feed
irregularities.detail: ESPN F1 publishes no odds; OLBG server HTML contains consensus tip counts but no prices (prices are injected client-side). The Odds and Market Value component is therefore always unscored.
irregularities.mitigation: Component recorded missing; market band capped and never promoted to HIGH on partial data.

irregularities.title: No per-race fastest-lap data from ESPN
irregularities.detail: ESPN competitor statistics expose place/pole/laps/pits but not the fastest lap of a race. ESPN circuit endpoint publishes the current lap record only.
irregularities.mitigation: Fastest-lap evidence comes from OLBG event-page year lists (secondary source) and, where identical, cross-checked against the ESPN circuit record (2025 Monza 1:20.901 = Lando Norris — verified on both).

irregularities.title: DNF classification requires per-driver status fetches
irregularities.detail: The scoreboard payload has competitor statuses as $refs; DNF is only known when the status endpoint is fetched (STATUS_RETIRED verified). History seasons are stored without status data to bound request volume.
irregularities.mitigation: last-5 DNF counts are only as complete as the statuses fetched; partial samples are flagged in missing[] and scored conservatively.

irregularities.title: Tyre strategy and pit-lap timing not published
irregularities.detail: Only pitsTaken counts exist; whether a driver pitted in the final five laps is unknown on any free feed.
irregularities.mitigation: Fastest-lap tyre strategy component always missing → market SKIPped per Step 3.

irregularities.title: No overtake counts or rankings
irregularities.detail: No free structured overtake statistic verified.
irregularities.mitigation: Overtaking ability and traffic-skill components scored as missing.

irregularities.title: Safety-car frequency and overtaking difficulty are not published
irregularities.detail: The prompt names circuit classes; data for frequency/difficulty is not available on free feeds.
irregularities.mitigation: Circuit classifications from the prompt are applied only as structural context; multipliers that need numeric frequency are missing.

irregularities.title: Upgrade packages / lap-time deltas not published
irregularities.detail: No source for floor/wing/PU upgrades or consistent lap-time improvement.
irregularities.mitigation: Car upgrade trajectory component scored as missing.

irregularities.title: Weather is forward-looking and volatile
irregularities.detail: Open-Meteo forecasts are used with source URL; forecasts change. >30% rain flags predictions as weather-dependent.
irregularities.mitigation: Weather influence surfaces only as a permitted external data point and a weather-dependence flag.
